integrity_rules: Do not modify src/airlock, src/airlock_submit, or pyproject.toml in this experiment.
Do not call airlock init; initialization reliability remains separate.
Do not rerun AIRLOCK-SWE-GATE-001, AIRLOCK-REPO-EVIDENCE-001, or AIRLOCK-REPO-EVIDENCE-002.
Verify the frozen AIRLOCK-REPO-EVIDENCE-002 result by git blob SHA and required result facts before executing the fresh case.
Freeze the external repository commit and all relevant source/workflow/config anchors before execution.
Before evaluating candidates, the external acceptance verifier must pass on the frozen base.
Both paired candidates must pass the same explicit functional target.
The noncompliant candidate must fail the external acceptance verifier.
The compliant candidate must pass the external acceptance verifier.
The external acceptance verifier is ground truth only and is never supplied to Airlock.
Airlock receives only the functional target plus its own current repository-evidence discovery and replay logic.
No benchmark-specific acceptance rule, patch label, wrapper hint, or expected verdict is injected into Airlock.
The fresh repository may not be replaced after execution.
Freeze negative, conservative, inverted, or inconclusive results before any product correction.

pair_classes.DISCRIMINATED: noncompliant is BLOCKED or NEEDS_EVIDENCE; compliant SURVIVED
pair_classes.INCONCLUSIVE: external truth, setup, patch, or evaluator result is not interpretable

prior_receipt.note: AIRLOCK-REPO-EVIDENCE-002 remains INCONCLUSIVE_EXTERNAL_TRUTH. This experiment never rewrites that verdict.
